home.heroTitle: Compose with AI, refine by hand
home.heroBody: {{appName}} pairs a full notation editor and piano roll with AI generation: describe the music you want, then edit every note.
home.featureEditorBody: Engraved notation and a piano roll over the same score, with full undo history.
home.featureAiBody: Generate whole pieces or regenerate a selection with candidate previews.
home.featureFormatsBody: Import and export standard formats that work with your other tools.

settings.title: Settings
settings.scoreDescription: How notes are spelled, and developer tools
settings.pitchDisplayHelp: Transposing instruments can show the pitch as written for the player, or as it sounds.

appearance.infoDescription: Your appearance preferences are saved locally and will be applied automatically on your next visit.

footer.tagline: Write, generate and play sheet music in your browser.

resources.title: Resources
resources.intro: Free archives of music you can bring straight into {{appName}}. Download a file, then use Import on the projects page.
resources.modarchiveBody: Tens of thousands of tracker modules — MOD, S3M, XM and IT — from the demoscene era onward.
resources.bitmidiBody: A large searchable collection of MIDI files, from classical to game and pop arrangements.
resources.musescoreBody: Community sheet music, much of it downloadable as MusicXML.
resources.imslpBody: The public-domain library of classical scores, including MusicXML for many works.
resources.freepatsBody: Free, openly licensed instrument samples and patch sets for playback.

community.title: Community
community.intro: Snapshots people have shared. Anyone can listen — no account needed.
community.searchPlaceholder: Search by title or who shared it

generateTrack.title: Generate track
generateTrack.intro: Adds one new track to this score, matching its key, tempo and length.
generateTrack.promptPlaceholder: A walking bass line under the melody

dashboard.generateScoreHint: Generate a whole score with AI
dashboard.emptyNoProjects: No projects yet. Create one, or import a MIDI/MusicXML/project file to get started.
dashboard.moduleDescription: Opens a tracker module (.MOD, .DSM, .S3M, .XM, .IT, .MPTM) as a new project. Notes are grouped by instrument rather than by channel, and the order list is flattened, so a pattern played three times becomes three sets of measures.
dashboard.projectDescription: Opens a project exported from this app as a new project. The one already open is untouched.

credits.title: Credits
credits.explanation: One credit writes one bar for one instrument. An eight-bar score for four instruments costs 32.
credits.noPackages: No credit packages are available right now. If this is a new deployment, the store still needs its products configured.
credits.loginRequired: Sign in to see your balance and buy credits.
credits.packageDescription: One credit writes one bar for one instrument.
credits.outOfCreditsBody: Generating needs credits, and your balance is empty. Top up to carry on — nothing you were working on has been lost.
